description: Renovate moves the pins of this repository: actions by commit hash with the version in a comment, images by digest under a '# tag: <tag>' marker, and runner labels.
The tool pins of scripts/install-tools, meson too, have a sha256 that Renovate cannot write. The job tools of freshness.yml reports a tool that is behind.
Digest, pin, pinDigest, patch and minor updates merge with no person: .github/workflows/bot-merge.yml approves and merges them when CI passes. A major update waits for a person.
platformAutomerge is false: the merge goes through bot-merge.yml, which checks that the diff only moves pins.

The regex manager reads Dockerfile, .github/workflows and scripts. The Dockerfile manager is off, because the base image is an ARG under a marker. scripts/check-image-pins reads the same markers. tests/static/89-bot-merge-guard.sh fails when a pin is not matched here, or when a rule merges a major update.

packageRules.description: Actions move one time each week in one pull request, and only to a release that is at least 3 days old.
Small updates merge when CI passes.
A major update waits for a person.
A runner label (runs-on) waits for a person: a new runner image changes the tools of every job.
Each pin of the Arch Linux base image moves in one pull request.

customManagers.description: An image pinned by digest under a '# tag: <tag>' marker, at most 3 lines above the pin.
